_disclaimer: Reference list for the BAYOU-NOVA proof of concept (2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge). The citations are real publications; everything else in this project is simulated. Not for clinical use.
verification_status: Bibliographic details of every entry marked verified were matched to a PubMed record or the publisher's own page on 2026-11-14 (Phase 5 entries) or 2026-11-15 (the five Medical Assistant entries added in Phase 6, and the 22 entries added in Phase 7 for the Learn tab). That check confirms the publication exists as cited. It is not a clinical review: no clinician has confirmed that each criterion is applied appropriately, and almost all of these sources were developed for people on Earth, not in spaceflight.
clinical_review_status: PENDING. A flight surgeon or other qualified clinician must review every Layer 1 criterion and its wording before any real use.
